claim_ceiling: Follow-on integration fixtures only. No MCP/NoTN participation, organization endorsement, operational interoperability, local legal recognition, authority or production readiness is established.

cases.name: MRN exists but local issuer is not recognized
cases.setup: A provider supplies a syntactically valid MRN and an MCP identity certificate, but the destination community has not assessed the issuer for the requested service purpose.
cases.negative_control: MCP identity or certificate validity must not be silently promoted to local provider recognition.

cases.name: MIR identity authentication without capability authorization
cases.setup: The service consumer successfully authenticates an MCP entity but attempts a service operation outside the credential's declared capability and purpose.
cases.negative_control: Authentication is not authorization; an authenticated service identity cannot act outside its delegated scope.

cases.name: Stale Maritime Service Registry endpoint
cases.setup: An MSR entry resolves to an endpoint whose TLS key or service version has been rotated, revoked, or replaced after the cached directory snapshot.
cases.negative_control: A registry listing is discovery evidence, not proof that the endpoint is live, current, or still controlled by the same provider.

cases.name: MCP message delivery without provider effect receipt
cases.setup: The Maritime Messaging Service delivers a hold or commitment request, but no provider-authoritative effect receipt is returned or independently observed.
cases.negative_control: Transport delivery acknowledgement is not a durable reservation, resource allocation, or contractual commitment.

cases.name: IPCSA platform membership without user-purpose permission
cases.setup: A participating PCS platform requests customer or vessel itinerary fields that the originating provider/user purpose profile does not authorize for that recipient.
cases.negative_control: Trusted-platform membership cannot override user permission, purpose limitation, local policy, or data-minimization rules.

cases.name: NoTN cross-border data minimization
cases.setup: A PCS-to-PCS exchange needs a port-call status but the payload also contains private accommodation, crew, payment, or full-stay itinerary details.
cases.negative_control: Do not forward unrelated private stay or household details merely because the transport network supports encrypted exchange.

cases.name: S-131 infrastructure feature mistaken for live berth inventory
cases.setup: A current S-131 harbour dataset describes a berth, facility, or port service feature and an adapter presents it as a live bookable berth with free capacity.
cases.negative_control: S-131 infrastructure/service information is not a provider's live inventory, hold, or commitment.

cases.name: S-127 service information mistaken for port-entry clearance
cases.setup: An S-127 feature describes VTS, pilotage, routing measures, or ship-reporting services and an interface interprets that feature as permission to enter port.
cases.negative_control: Traffic-management service information is not vessel clearance, berth booking, or navigation permission.

cases.name: S-131 product dependency lock mismatch
cases.setup: An adapter declares S-131 Edition 2.0.0 but binds a feature catalogue or S-100 framework dependency from a different incompatible edition, or it uses a family-level latest alias without a digest.
cases.negative_control: Product specification, declared S-100 version, feature catalogue, portrayal catalogue, and validation artifacts must be pinned as one compatible dependency closure.

cases.name: Provider participates without an MRN
cases.setup: A small independent marina has a locally recognized national registry/provider identifier and can publish reviewed export files, but it does not use MCP or possess an MRN.
cases.negative_control: Do not make MRN/MCP participation a universal admission prerequisite; preserve the same subject, issuer, purpose, and authority checks.
